_comment: Reviewed floor for the Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi flood. Deaths currently NDRRMA / MoHA, 18 Bhadra 19:00 (355+218+212+177+72+60+38+127 = 1259). Uncontacted about 5,083 — the board publishes its parts as approximations (DAO Nuwakot ~2,340 + DAO Rasuwa ~2,130 + foreign 583 = 5,053), and IANS, citing the same evening sitrep, reports 5,053; both figures are on the panel and neither is quietly picked. Injured 304 hospitalised: NDRRMA now heads its board with 5,384 by adding army field treatment 3,206 and armed-police 1,874 to it, and Atlas keeps those as labels the way it has since 292 — treatments delivered are not flood injuries. Deployed 21,402 / NDRRMA rescued graphic 12,038. The ten-minute cycle reads nirajbhusal.github.io/rasuwa-flood-bulletin and merge_sitrep replaces a group only when its parts add up; a failed scrape leaves these numbers standing. Deaths never go down — Nepal Police (more than 1,250 dead, 4,758 missing on 4 September) is a separate running count, and a lagging compilation must not put 1,204 back over NDRRMA 1259. The overview also shows live government figures beside this grid (BIPAD corridor incidents, NDRRMA rescued-persons totals, OPMCM portal counters); those come straight from the portals and are never merged into these numbers. Two rules govern edits. (1) Never sum across groups that the source keeps apart - the `exclusive` flags and `do_not_merge` notes exist because several of these counts overlap, and adding them would invent casualties. (2) Every breakdown must sum to its own stated total; app/domains/flood/merge.py re-adds them at load and the page shows a warning if either stops reconciling. Do not add Tibet (16 dead) or India's 9 onto Nepal's 1259.

notes.body_en: Kathmandu DEOC still lists 88 injured brought to valley hospitals as a separate collection from the official 304. Kathmandu District Police said on 31 August that 33 of 48 patients at the National Trauma Centre had been discharged and 15 remained in care. Rasuwa Hospital Dhunche reports 74, of whom 49 were discharged and 24 referred. Police assistance desks are at Bir Hospital and the Trauma Centre. These hospital counts are not added to the 304.

notes.title_en: Rs 1 billion from the PM fund, to be sent
notes.body_en: The Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund operating committee decided on 16 Bhadra to send Rs 1 billion immediately to flood-affected areas. That is a disbursement from the fund, not extra cash on top of the Rs 7.30 billion already in the banks. Source: Office of the Prime Minister on nepal.gov.np.
notes.body_ne: प्रधानमन्त्री दैवी प्रकोप उद्धार कोष सञ्चालन समितिले १६ भदौमा बाढी प्रभावित क्षेत्रमा एक अर्ब तत्काल पठाउने निर्णय गरेको छ। यो कोषबाट बाहिरिने रकम हो, बैंकमा रहेको ७ अर्ब ३० करोडमाथि थप होइन। स्रोत: प्रधानमन्त्री कार्यालय, nepal.gov.np।

notes.body_en: The monsoon response command at the Ministry of Home Affairs decided on 16 Bhadra to send Rs 6.75 crore to 15 palikas in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Tanahun. That matches an allocation the DRRM executive committee made on 11 Bhadra — count it once, and do not add it onto the Prime Minister's fund cash total. Source: MoHA on nepal.gov.np.
notes.body_ne: गृह मन्त्रालयको मनसुन प्रतिकार्य कमाण्डले १६ भदौमा रसुवा, नुवाकोट, धादिङ, गोरखा र तनहुँका १५ पालिकालाई ६ करोड ७५ लाख पठाउने निर्णय गरेको छ। यो ११ भदौको विपद् कार्यकारी समितिको विनियोजनसँग मेल खान्छ — एक पटक मात्र गन्नुहोस्, प्रधानमन्त्री कोषको मौज्दातमाथि नजोड्नुहोस्। स्रोत: गृह मन्त्रालय, nepal.gov.np।

name_lists.do_not_merge_en: Eight lists, published separately by different offices. The same person can appear on more than one, so they are never added into a single rescue total. The official injured figure stays 304. NDRRMA's graphic of 12,038 rescued is a separate count from these named lists.
name_lists.do_not_merge_ne: आठ सूची, फरक-फरक कार्यालयले छुट्टै प्रकाशित गरेका। एउटै व्यक्ति एकभन्दा बढी सूचीमा पर्न सक्छ, त्यसैले यी एउटै उद्धार जम्मामा जोडिँदैनन्। आधिकारिक घाइते संख्या ३०४ नै रहन्छ। एनडीआरआरएमएको उद्धार ग्राफिक १२,०३८ यी नामावलीभन्दा छुट्टै गणना हो।

missing_found.do_not_merge_en: Public reports, not official figures. Lists stay separate and names are not merged across them. The official uncontacted figure stays about 5,083.
missing_found.do_not_merge_ne: सार्वजनिक जानकारी, आधिकारिक तथ्यांक होइन। सूचीहरू छुट्टै रहन्छन् र नाम मिसाइँदैन। आधिकारिक सम्पर्कविहीन संख्या करिब ५,०८३ नै रहन्छ।
